scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix back-end && npm install --prefix front-end && npm run prisma:deploy --prefix back-end && npm run seed --prefix back-end
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --prefix back-end" "npm run dev --prefix front-end"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix back-end && npm run build --prefix front-end
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm start --prefix back-end" "npm run preview --prefix front-end -- --port 5173 --strictPort"
scripts.test:types: npm run typecheck --prefix back-end && npm run typecheck --prefix front-end
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit:back && npm run test:unit:front
